brief:
Israeli settlers set fire to a mosque in the West Bank as Israeli forces conducted raids in multiple villages, Al Jazeera English reported. The incident was part of a broader surge in settler violence in the occupied territory.

In a separate incident in the town of Beita, south of Nablus, settlers attacked a boy. The attacks coincided with military operations by Israeli forces across West Bank communities.
dek: Settlers also attacked a boy in a separate incident in the town of Beita, south of Nablus.
title: Settlers torch mosque, attack boy during West Bank raids
